evidence: The films were amorphous according to X-ray diffraction. The film density was 7.1 g/cm3 for the film deposited at 150 °C and increased to 7.6 g/cm3 for films deposited at 250 °C. The film roughness was also analyzed from XRR: the rms roughness was 1.4 nm for a 90 nm thick film deposited at 250 °C with the Ta-O and increased to 2.6 nm with the H2O-Ta-O sequencing.
